payload.claim: Criterion 2's witness description sets up a child naming a shallower parent first and the deepest second, plus 'a grandparent it never names' that also opens a pull request. For the wrong_versions entry 'Every open pull request is exempt' to be killed, the witness needs at least one open PR genuinely off the full depends_on walk, so it should still refuse. The prose does not disambiguate whether this grandparent is reached transitively through one of the two named parents (and so is legitimately exempt) or is truly disconnected from the walk (the needed off-walk refuser). Read one way the witness kills the all-exempt wrong version; read the other way every PR in the scenario is on the walk and that mutant would survive by coincidence.
